Marta G: Heads-up: third-party assessment next month. New requirement from legal: chain-of-custody proof for any exported logs + signed remediation affidavit from engineers before retest. Window TBD but want the playbook nailed down now. @Sanjay R can you confirm what metadata the KMS proxy can emit to help prove provenance?

Sanjay R: We can emit structured audit events with fields: request_id, key_id, caller, x-pt-session, nonce, and proxy_signature (HMAC over payload with rotating key). That proxy_signature plus exported SIEM snapshot hash should be enough for tamper-evidence.

Jess L: Ok. From the SIEM side we can: 1) make the pt index immutable for 14 days, 2) export a gzipped snapshot at EOD to a WORM bucket, and 3) publish the SHA256 of that snapshot to our internal attestations registry. I'll own INF-SIEM-999 ticket for this.

Marta G: Good. Legal also wants an engineer affidavit that lists the fix steps and verification commands. Can we require a signed markdown file attached to the PR before retest?

Ryan T: Sounds reasonable. Operationally: triage ack within 4 business hours; P0/P1 require emergency patch window and oncall involvement. Remediation acceptance criteria for retest: PR merged, CI green, one regression test reproducing the PoC, ops smoke-run logs attached, and signed_affidavit.md present in PR. Retest slot locked until all are present.

Theo P: Quick Q: how do we validate proxy_signature on exported snapshot? Do we keep proxy signing keys separate from KMS master keys?

Sanjay R: Yes. Proxy uses a separate ephemeral signing key rotated hourly and we publish the public key for that hour alongside the snapshot SHA256. Validation steps: 1) verify snapshot SHA256 matches attestation, 2) verify proxy_signature using published public key, 3) ensure request_id/key_id sequence matches expected session table. We'll add a small verifier script to infra repo.

Jess L: Ticket INF-SIEM-999 created: https://tickets.redwood.dev/INF-SIEM-999. Will set immutability and scheduled export. Also adding a saved view that surfaces proxy_signature and nonce fields for quick spot checks.

OpsBot: action: ephemeral role created assessor-chain-20250910 ttl=6h issued_by=@Marta G. SIEM index pt-chainproof-20250910 created.

Marta G: Action items: Sanjay -> add proxy_signature and nonce to audit emission + publish verifier script PR; Jess -> complete SIEM immutability/export and attestation registry entry; Ryan -> update triage & retest checklist to require signed_affidavit.md and snapshot SHA; Theo -> review verifier script and threat model for signing keys. Dry-run scheduled Wed 2025-09-03 15:00 UTC to exercise full chain (emission -> export -> verify). :thumbsup:
